title: Filolial Road
paragraphs: This is a continuation from the final episode of *The Spear Hero’s Second Chance*. It’s the “True Tutorial” arc.
“Father! Big Sister! Filo-oooooo! Wait for meeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee!”
I barely managed to catch up to Father’s cart as it raced away. But after glancing at me with a face like he’d just swallowed a bitter pill, he turned his gaze forward with a tense expression.
“Filo! Run faster!”
“G-Guaaaaaaaah!”
Filo-tan showed some real grit at Father’s request! This is it! She’s actually enjoying this game of tag with me! Woaaaaah, I won’t lose!

Just as I was thinking that and showing off my leg strength to Filo-tan and Father, the cart jolted, and the figure sitting on the back looked like it was about to tumble off. Oh, that’s Big Sister! Isn’t that a little dangerous?
“Raphtalia! Are you okay!?”
“U… uh…”
She looked completely drained and was about to fall off at any moment. She seems to be in pretty bad shape.
“Here we go!”
I gave her a gentle shove to get her back onto the cart, then hopped on myself.
“I caught up to you! I win this game of tag!”
“Tch… He’s not even out of breath.”
And so, Father pulled on the reins and stopped Filo-chan. Then, while holding his shield in a defensive stance, he kept glancing over at Big Sister. What kind of reaction is this, I wonder?
“What’s the matter?”
“Send Raphtalia over here.”
“Yes, sir. She doesn’t look well.”
Following Father’s instructions, I handed Big Sister over to him. Seeing my attitude, Father furrowed his brow and tilted his head.
“Would you like me to cast an anti-nausea spell or a Recovery spell?”
“Are you planning to make Raphtalia drink poison!?”

Poison? Why on earth would I need to make my Older Sister drink poison? If anyone’s going to drink it, it should be the Crimson Swine. I’d like to make him drink a poison that makes him writhe in agony, just like what he did to Fleon-chan. Well, he’s already out of this world, though. HAHAHA.
“I wouldn’t do such a thing. You don’t look too well, so you should probably get some rest.”
“You’re the one saying that! Who do you think is to blame for us having to run away!?”
Let me think about it. …No matter how I look at it, I can’t think of anyone but Crimson Swine!
“It’s Crimson Swine’s fault! I’ll never forgive that guy!”
“No! It’s your fault for killing him!”
“Hahaha, wasn’t it because you, Father, demanded I take him out?”
“I never said that! I was just thinking it!”

Oh, he’s even more hostile than Father in my memories. In my hazy memories, Father used to sigh a lot when talking to me and always seemed gloomy. However, it’s the greatest honor to be able to sense what’s really on his mind. I’ll keep this up and prove myself to be his right-hand man!
“Well, the Lazy Pig got away, but that’s a trivial matter.”
“What do you mean, a trivial matter…? Are you really okay? In every way?”

As he said that, Father looked at me with concern. This Motoyasu—tears of emotion are welling up in my eyes. Unlike in the previous loop, you still have a kind heart that wants to be closer to Father from the first world! That’s exactly the kind of Father you are. I’ll follow you wherever you go!
“Oh! That worried look in Father’s eyes! I, Motoyasu, am truly delighted!”
“That’s why I told you to stop fooling around!　Oh, for heaven’s sake!”
“Guh?”
Oh? Filo-chan seems concerned about us and is looking this way, glancing around. Leave it to me, Filo-chan. I’ll definitely show you the path to glory alongside Father… the Filolial Road.
“Ugh… w-what happened?”

Big Sister, who had been slumped over, opened her eyes and turned toward Father. Then, realizing I was there, she staggered and tried to stand up hurriedly. Her expression was pained, but it was also clearly on guard. Hmm… Why am I being treated with such suspicion?
“Actually, a little while ago… when Filo kicked Motoyasu—who was laughing his head off—that bastard snapped, started babbling nonsense, and went and killed that woman right in front of me.”
“Huh!? R-really!?”
“Yeah, I’m not exaggerating. He really did kill her with that spear.”

The older sister looked at me with a shocked expression. So, I gave a firm nod. It’s an undeniable fact, after all. The Crimson Swine is a being unworthy of living in this world. In fact, the longer he stays alive, the more vitality is drained from the world.
“I’m not lying, you know? I killed that scourge of the world, the Crimson Swine!”

The surprised Older Sister looked at Father, and he nodded silently. She’s still staring at me with a look that says she can’t believe it. All right, I should have made it clear by now that I’m on her side. From here on out, I’ll prove that I’m someone she can trust.
“The orders of Father are absolute. That’s the condition for making you part of our team, after all.”
“Father? Naofumi-sama, did you set a condition for letting him join us?”
“I didn’t say that! He’s been acting like this the whole time. Can’t you do something about it?!”
Father is running his fingers through his hair. You’ll damage your cuticles if you keep doing that!
“W-what on earth… What do you mean, ‘strange’?”
“I’ve come from the future, and I know everything. The shock from earlier brought it all back to me.”
“The future…?”

My Older Sister is looking at me with furrowed brows. Well, I suppose it’s hard to make her believe me right away. But I’ll keep talking patiently, just like in the previous loop. Because I believe that’s the true path to peace.
“So you knew all that and still killed him?”
“He’s a menace—there’s not the slightest reason to let him live.”
“Well, I agree with that… but I’ll be the one taking the blame for killing that woman, won’t I!”
“Is there a problem with taking the blame?”
“Of course there is! You’re planning to frame me again, aren’t you?!”
Oh? Father’s reaction… Ah, come to think of it, he doesn’t know the real reason why he’s been framed. In that case, I suppose I’d best start by explaining that.
“Um, what do you mean by ‘Father’?”
“Because you’re Filo-chan’s Father, of course.”
“Guh?”
“Filo’s… well, considering your relationship with Naofumi-sama, I suppose you could be considered Filo’s foster father…”
It seems Big Sister is also starting to recover from her motion sickness.
“So, Father, don’t you want to know why you were falsely accused of rape?”
At my question, Father glared at me intensely while clenching his fists. Then, as if choosing his words carefully, he said:
“…What do you know? What are you trying to say with that mocking attitude?”
“It’s the truth I learned from the future. Of course, the things I did without realizing it are facts that can’t be changed, but I’m truly remorseful.”
“Just spit it out. Well… since you wiped that guy out, I suppose I might as well hear you out a little.”
“You believe me!?”

“You can’t just pull off a massacre right in front of me and get away with a ‘Hehehe, just kidding.’ At the very least, the Motoyasu I’ve known up until now would never have done something like that.”
“That’s… true.”

Just as I expected from Father. You really do know me well. Big Sister seems convinced, too. It’s true—the me before I recalled my memories of the future would never have killed Crimson Swine. I’ll use this as a breakthrough to gain their trust!
“Whether I end up messing up again or manage to get away with this, since Filo ran after me and caught up, I have no choice but to listen to what he has to say.”
He’s quick to assess the situation. I’d like to learn from that.
“Then I’ll tell you. This country, Melromarc, has a state religion that regards the Shield Hero as the enemy.”
